name: Chevalia Estate
overview: Emaar Properties' newest ultra-luxury villa complex, Chevalia Estate, is situated in the center of Dubai Investment Park (DIP). This exclusive enclave of just 80 villas, situated within the renowned Grand Polo Club & Resort, embodies the essence of equestrian elegance combined with contemporary architectural perfection. Offering discriminating customers a unique combination of tranquility, exclusivity, and refinement, Chevalia Estate stands out in Dubai's upscale real estate market with its nature-integrated design, limited availability, and horse-centered lifestyle.
